# Ensure all tables render inline at 10pt body font size without horizontal overflow or float page isolation,
# and replace em/en-dashes with plain hyphens (-).
sanitize_latex_text <- function (arg0_text, arg1_in_table = FALSE) {
  text <- as.character(arg0_text)
  if (length(text) == 0 || is.na(text) || !nzchar(text)) return("")
  text <- gsub("`", "", text, fixed = TRUE)
  parts <- strsplit(text, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  out_parts <- character(length(parts))
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
      out_parts[i] <- "$"
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "^2", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      out_parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)&", "\\\\&", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)%", "\\\\%", p, perl = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("(?<!\\\\)_", "\\\\_", p, perl = TRUE)
      if (isTRUE(arg1_in_table)) {
        p <- gsub("\\_", "\\_\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("/", "/\\allowbreak{}", p, fixed = TRUE)
        # Keep thousands-separated numbers and BC/AD dates on a single line inside table cells
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\b[1-9][0-9]{0,2}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("(?<=\\.[0-9]{3}) (?=[0-9]{3}\\b)", ".", p, perl = TRUE)
        p <- gsub("([0-9])\\s*(BC|AD)\\b", "\\1\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
        # Prevent line breaks immediately after a leading negative sign (e.g. -10000)
        p <- gsub("(^|\\s|\\()-([0-9])", "\\1\\\\mbox{-}\\2", p, perl = TRUE)
      }
      out_parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(out_parts, collapse = ""))
}

sanitize_prose_unicode_for_latex <- function (arg0_line) {
  line_str <- as.character(arg0_line)
  if (length(line_str) == 0 || is.na(line_str) || !nzchar(line_str)) return(line_str)
  parts <- strsplit(line_str, "(?<=\\$)|(?=\\$)", perl = TRUE)[[1]]
  in_math <- FALSE
  for (i in seq_along(parts)) {
    p <- parts[i]
    if (identical(p, "$")) {
      in_math <- !in_math
    } else if (in_math) {
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " \\rightarrow ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", " \\times ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "\\Delta ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", " \\approx ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    } else {
      p <- gsub(
        "\\b(Figures?|Figs?\\.|Tables?|Tabs?\\.|Images?|Definitions?|Sections?|Appendix)(?:\\s+|~)\\\\ref\\{([^}]+)\\}",
        "\\\\crdxref{\\1}{\\2}",
        p,
        perl = TRUE
      )
      p <- gsub("\u2192", " to ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00d7", "x", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u0394", "$\\Delta$", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2248", "~", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("km\u00b2", "km\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("m\u00b2", "m\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("R\u00b2", "R\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u00b2", "\\textsuperscript{2}", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2013", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("\u2014", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("---", " - ", p, fixed = TRUE)
      p <- gsub("--", "-", p, fixed = TRUE)
      parts[i] <- p
    }
  }
  return(paste(parts, collapse = ""))
}

orig_render_figure_template <- render_figure_template
render_figure_template <- function (arg0_file_path, arg1_options = NULL) {
  options <- if (!is.null(arg1_options)) arg1_options else list()
  options$placement <- "!htbp"
  if (is.null(options$max_height) || identical(options$max_height, "none")) {
    options$max_height <- "0.42\\textheight"
  }
  return(orig_render_figure_template(arg0_file_path, options))
}

```{r load-stadester-json, include=FALSE}
gaz_map <- jsonlite::fromJSON(GAZETTEER_JSON_FILE, simplifyVector = FALSE)
settlements_list <- unname(gaz_map)

# Sort chronologically by first occupied year, then alphabetically by name
first_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(99999)
  return(min(yrs))
}
last_year_num <- function (arg0_s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(arg0_s$population))
  if (length(yrs) == 0) return(-99999)
  return(max(yrs))
}

ord_idx <- order(
  vapply(settlements_list, first_year_num, numeric(1)),
  vapply(settlements_list, function (s) as.character(s$name), character(1))
)
settlements_list <- settlements_list[ord_idx]

translit_cyr <- function (arg0_str) {
  s <- as.character(arg0_str)
  if (!nzchar(s)) return("")
  # Map Cyrillic characters to Latin so Karla 10pt renders every character cleanly in XeLaTeX
  cyr <- c(
    "А","Б","В","Г","Д","Е","Ё","Ж","З","И","Й","К","Л","М","Н","О","П","Р","С","Т","У","Ф","Х","Ц","Ч","Ш","Щ","Ъ","Ы","Ь","Э","Ю","Я",
    "а","б","в","г","д","е","ё","ж","з","и","й","к","л","м","н","о","п","р","с","т","у","ф","х","ц","ч","ш","щ","ъ","ы","ь","э","ю","я",
    "Φ","α","ν","γ","ό","ρ","ε","ι","Κ","ῆ","π","ο","Πα","τ","ύ","ς","Τ","ά","ϊ","μ","β","η","К"
  )
  lat <- c(
    "A","B","V","G","D","E","Yo","Zh","Z","I","Y","K","L","M","N","O","P","R","S","T","U","F","Kh","Ts","Ch","Sh","Shch","","Y","","E","Yu","Ya",
    "a","b","v","g","d","e","yo","zh","z","i","y","k","l","m","n","o","p","r","s","t","u","f","kh","ts","ch","sh","shch","","y","","e","yu","ya",
    "Ph","a","n","g","o","r","e","i","K","e","p","o","Pa","t","y","s","T","a","i","m","b","e","K"
  )
  for (i in seq_along(cyr)) {
    s <- gsub(cyr[i], lat[i], s, fixed = TRUE)
  }
  return(s)
}

fmt_other_names <- function (arg0_s) {
  onames <- unlist(arg0_s$other_names)
  if (length(onames) == 0) return("-")
  clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  clean_vec <- clean_vec[nzchar(clean_vec) & tolower(clean_vec) != tolower(arg0_s$name)]
  if (length(clean_vec) == 0) {
    clean_vec <- unique(vapply(onames, translit_cyr, character(1)))
  }
  return(paste(head(clean_vec, 2L), collapse = "; "))
}

fmt_year_lbl <- function (arg0_y) {
  y <- as.numeric(arg0_y)
  if (y < 0) return(paste0(abs(round(y)), "BC"))
  return(paste0(round(y), "AD"))
}

fmt_span <- function (arg0_s) {
  y1 <- first_year_num(arg0_s)
  y2 <- last_year_num(arg0_s)
  if (y1 == y2) return(fmt_year_lbl(y1))
  if (y1 < 0 && y2 < 0) return(paste0(abs(y1), "-", abs(y2), "BC"))
  if (y1 > 0 && y2 > 0) return(paste0(y1, "-", y2, "AD"))
  return(paste0(fmt_year_lbl(y1), " - ", fmt_year_lbl(y2)))
}

fmt_num_eu <- function (arg0_val) {
  if (is.null(arg0_val) || is.na(arg0_val)) return("-")
  v <- as.numeric(arg0_val)
  if (v >= 1000000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000000.0, format = "f", digits = 2L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "M"))
  }
  if (v >= 1000) {
    s <- formatC(v / 1000.0, format = "f", digits = 1L, big.mark = ".", decimal.mark = ",")
    s <- sub("(,[0-9]*?[1-9])0+$", "\\1", s, perl = TRUE)
    s <- sub(",0+$", "", s, perl = TRUE)
    return(paste0(s, "k"))
  }
  return(as.character(round(v)))
}

fmt_coord_pair <- function (arg0_coords) {
  lat <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[1]])))
  lon <- gsub("\\.", ",", sprintf("%.2f", as.numeric(arg0_coords[[2]])))
  return(paste0(lat, "°N, ", lon, "°E"))
}

fmt_pop_series <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin = -99999, arg2_ymax = 99999) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  parts <- vapply(keep, function (idx) {
    paste0(fmt_year_lbl(yrs[idx]), ": ", fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
  }, character(1))
  return(paste(parts, collapse = "; "))
}

get_pop_window_val <- function (arg0_s, arg1_ymin, arg2_ymax) {
  pop_map <- arg0_s$population
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(pop_map))
  vals <- as.numeric(unlist(pop_map))
  keep <- which(yrs >= arg1_ymin & yrs <= arg2_ymax)
  if (length(keep) == 0) return("-")
  # Take the latest year in the window
  idx <- keep[which.max(yrs[keep])]
  return(fmt_num_eu(vals[idx]))
}
```

# Abstract

Across the 245k km² of the Lower Volga, settlement swung repeatedly between the open Kalmyk and Trans-Volga steppes and the river corridor of the Volga Delta, the Volga-Akhtuba Floodplain and the Saratov-Volgograd valley. From Mesolithic and Neolithic fishing camps at Seroglazovka, Kairshak, Varfolomeyevka (60-100 inhabitants in 5500BC) and Dzhangar [@koltsov2005mezolit; @yudin2004varfolomeyevka; @baratskov2015itogi] and Copper Age cemeteries at Khvalynsk I-II [@agapov1990khvalynskiy], permanent villages spread across the northern river valleys during the Late Bronze Age Srubnaya period (1500BC) [@malov2008nizhneye; @lopatin2014nachalo] before giving way to Sauromatian and Sarmatian nomadic centres such as Kosika and Verkhnoye Pogromnoye [@skripkin2012chislennosti]. In the Middle Ages, the delta and floodplain hosted the largest cities on the Lower Volga: Khazar Itil at Semibugry/Barany Bugor (30k in 900AD) and Samosdelka/Saksin (20k in 1200AD) [@vasilyev2015saksin; @vasilyev2020samosdelka; @solovyev2022semibugry], followed under the Golden Horde (1340AD) by Sarai al-Jadid at Tsarevskoye (85k), Sarai Batu at Selitrennoye (68k), Hajji-Tarkhan (22k), Ukek with its 53 rural villages (9,5k urban and 15k rural) and Beldzhamen (7,5k) [@yegorov1985geografiya; @nedashkovsky2010goroda; @pigarev2021topografii; @shigapov2022selishch]. After Timur sacked the floodplain capitals in 1395-1396AD, Russian garrison towns founded at Astrakhan (1558), Tsaritsyn (1589), Saratov (1590) and Kamyshin (1668), together with the 104 Volga German colonies established in 1764-1767 and the Inner (Bukey) Kazakh centre of Khanskaya Stavka (1801), grew into a dense network of river ports and farming towns led in 1897 by Saratov (137,1k), Astrakhan (112,9k), Tsaritsyn (55,2k) and Volsk (27,1k) [@pleve1998nemetskiye; @doenninghaus2011nemetskikh; @belousov2019bukeyevskoy; @troynitsky1904saratov; @troynitsky1904astrakhan].

# Methodology

This gazetteer compiles 146 camps, villages, towns and farming colonies across the Lower Volga from 10000BC to 1900AD, giving historical and alternative names, geographic coordinates and population estimates at benchmark dates.

Population figures are derived from excavated pit-house floor areas and cemetery cohorts for Mesolithic, Neolithic, Copper Age, Bronze Age Srubnaya and Sarmatian sites [@koltsov2005mezolit; @smagin2018mikrolitov; @yudin2004varfolomeyevka; @baratskov2015itogi; @vybornov2022khronologiya; @agapov1990khvalynskiy; @tsibin2019maksimovka; @malov2008nizhneye; @lopatin2014nachalo; @skripkin2012chislennosti; @balabanova2009khronologicheskiye], urban and rural settlement excavations for Khazar Itil, Pre-Mongol Saksin and Golden Horde cities [@solovyev2022semibugry; @vasilyev2015saksin; @vasilyev2020samosdelka; @zilivinskaya2014ocherki; @yegorov1985geografiya; @fyodorovdavydov1994goroda; @nedashkovsky2000ukek; @nedashkovsky2010goroda; @nedashkovsky2022predmety; @shigapov2022selishch; @zeleneev2018selitrennom; @pigarev2021topografii] and Russian garrison rolls, Imperial tax revisions (*revizii*), Volga German colony censuses, Kalmyk and Inner (Bukey) Kazakh Horde records and the 1897 Census [@zaitsev2006astrakhanskoye; @syzranov2014astrakhani; @trepavlov2016nogayskoy; @moiseev2015stepnyye; @kabuzan1963narodonaseleniye; @solovyov2013saratovskoy; @brylyov2018volgogradskoy; @pleve1998nemetskiye; @doenninghaus2011nemetskikh; @ochirov2008tyurkoyazychnyye; @okonova2012migratsii; @kyshpanakov2026kalmyki; @belousov2019bukeyevskoy; @pirova2020tatarakh; @troynitsky1904saratov; @troynitsky1904astrakhan].

# Results

## Early Camps, Bronze Age Villages and Sarmatian Sites

```{r tab-volga-ancient, results='asis'}
v_ancient_list <- Filter(function (s) first_year_num(s) <= 400, settlements_list)

df_v_ancient <- do.call(rbind, lapply(v_ancient_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    Span = fmt_span(s),
    Pop_History = fmt_pop_series(s, -10000, 400),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_v_ancient,
  list(
    caption = "Coordinates, occupied spans and population estimates derived from pit-house floor areas and cemetery cohorts for Mesolithic, Neolithic, Copper Age, Srubnaya and Sarmatian sites along the Lower Volga.",
    label = "tab:volga-ancient",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical / Alternative Names", "Coords", "Occupied Span", "Population Estimates by Date"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```

## Khazar, Saksin and Golden Horde Towns and Villages

```{r tab-volga-medieval, results='asis'}
v_med_list <- Filter(function (s) {
  yrs <- as.numeric(names(s$population))
  any(yrs >= 700 & yrs <= 1555)
}, settlements_list)

df_v_med <- do.call(rbind, lapply(v_med_list, function (s) {
  data.frame(
    Settlement = s$name,
    Other_Names = fmt_other_names(s),
    Coords = fmt_coord_pair(s$coords),
    P_800_900 = get_pop_window_val(s, 750, 920),
    P_1200 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1100, 1220),
    P_1300 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1250, 1320),
    P_1340 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1330, 1365),
    P_1380_1550 = get_pop_window_val(s, 1370, 1555),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}))

render_table_template(
  df_v_med,
  list(
    caption = "Estimated populations at five medieval benchmark windows for Khazar delta ports, Pre-Mongol Saksin, the Golden Horde capitals and their satellite farming villages and the Astrakhan Khanate.",
    label = "tab:volga-medieval",
    col_names = c("Settlement", "Historical Names", "Coords", "800-900AD", "1150-1200AD", "1260-1320AD", "1340AD", "1380-1550AD"),
    scale_to_fit = FALSE
  )
)
```
